question: What supreme status is attributed to the goddess whose form is the bīja klīṃ?
premises: A goddess has the form of the bīja klīṃ.
She is identified by a relative clause.
inference: She whose form is the bīja klīṃ is proclaimed as the supreme one.
plain_english: She who has the form of the bīja klīṃ is proclaimed as the supreme one.
